prerequisites: Prior knowledge of the contents of the Theory of Structures and Industrial Constructions course is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Know and apply current technical regulations in the field of reinforced and prestressed concrete structure design.
Know and use software for the design and calculation of concrete structures used in laboratory practices.
Design, dimension, and check real concrete structural elements, including basic knowledge of soil types and the design and dimensioning of foundations.
Carry out a project work both individually and in a group, taking into account different organizational conditions and a multilingual environment.
Draft, sign, and develop industrial projects related to concrete construction.

teaching_methods: Autonomous work (study, exercises, problems, practical assignments)

assessment_methods.method: Laboratory practice attendance and report submission (P2)
Practical exam calculating a reinforced concrete structure with CYPECAD (P2)

assessment_rules: For students who completed laboratory practices and reports, the final grade is 0.8 * P1 + 0.2 * P2, provided a minimum of 4/10 is obtained in both P1 and P2, and attendance to practical classes is 85% or higher. Otherwise, the grade is the minimum of the calculated grade and 4.0. For students in differentiated evaluation, those who did not complete laboratory practices or reports, the final grade is 0.8 * P1 + 0.2 * P2, provided a minimum of 4/10 is obtained in P1 (written exam) and P2 (practical exam with CYPECAD). Otherwise, the grade is the minimum of the calculated grade and 4.0. In case of doubt regarding the authorship of any evaluable test or the use of unauthorized means, students may be asked for a face-to-face defense.
